description: isometric pixel art small town for a trucking tycoon game map, on a transparent background, seen from the high angle of an isometric tycoon map: a small mountain timber town: a sawmill with a log yard and a smoking stack, a motel and a diner on the highway, pine woods pressing in, a river with a steel bridge, a white church, a two-lane highway passing through with a tiny semi truck, highly detailed HD painterly pixel art shading with layered depth, warm late-afternoon light, saturated palette, the whole town fitting inside the frame with clear space around it, standing on flat ground that fades out to transparency at its edges with no platform, block or base edge under it, never any words, letters or labels
